dex.text: A little wicker basket with a pilot light that never quite goes out. Hops about the field at dawn, puffing warm air at anyone who looks chilly.
dex.fact: In 1783 a hot-air balloon built by the Montgolfier brothers carried the first people on a free flight, over Paris.

dex.text: Rises at first light with a roar of its burner, all stripes and good cheer, and drifts wherever the wind fancies. Lands in a farmer's field, apologises, and takes off again.
dex.fact: The Bristol International Balloon Fiesta at Ashton Court has run since 1979. Hot air rises because it is less dense than the cooler air around it.
